scenario.name: Intermittent internal name failures from expired secondary zone
scenario.description: Zone transfers from the primary to the secondary DNS server have been failing on TSIG validation; the secondary's copy of corp.example.com expires and it answers SERVFAIL for internal names.

incident.title: Internal applications intermittently fail to open by name at all offices
incident.description: Users at every branch report that ERP and intranet sometimes fail with 'server not found' and work on retry. Internet sites are mostly fine.
symptoms: Intermittent 'server not found' for internal names

ground_truth.root_cause: DC1-SRV-DNS-02 can no longer transfer corp.example.com from DC1-SRV-DNS-01 because TSIG signature verification fails; its secondary copy of the zone expired at incident onset and it now returns SERVFAIL for every internal name, so clients that query the secondary fail intermittently.
